youtube.title: What if Vice City was real for 24 hours?
youtube.description:
Spoiler: it basically is. It's called Miami. 🌴
The world's busiest cruise port, about 1.3 million alligators in Florida, and iguanas that freeze and fall out of palm trees on cold nights.
Which one surprised you? Comment A, B or C 👇

Sources: PortMiami (8.2M cruise passengers, FY2024) · Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (alligators) · National Weather Service Miami (falling iguanas)
